name: custom2-pair
description: Two endpoints with one link pair, for single-instance TP2 scenarios on the panel backend (a single NPU is refused by the backend's network parser). Normalized units. maxwin 2 MiB as in the hybrid N=64 fixtures: with -nocc the window is the whole message and an 8 MiB TP2 all-reduce chunk overflows a 4000-packet queue (3072 retransmissions in the first run).
